newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean values slip.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean values slip.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean bids were lower on Monday in response to limit gains in CBOT soybeans, export sources said.
"We're just down with the board being up," an exporter said. "Farmers will like these prices, so we're expecting more movement."
CBOT soybean futures surged the 30-cent per bushel limit on Monday amid speculation the U.S. Agriculture Department would further trim already tight 1996-97 ending stocks.
USDA pegged ending stocks at 140 million bushels in last month's crop report.
FOB wheat values were unchanged in quiet dealings.
